answer: Each agent must stake funds that are slashed when its attestations prove false, so spawning fake identities multiplies the attacker's cost instead of being free. Trust then accrues like shale laid down layer by layer through verified work, and a newcomer begins as a mere ember of credibility that only steady, checkable contributions can grow, while its sable-dark ledger of past behavior makes cheap re-entry visible, since a fresh identity cannot inherit the history of a burned one.
